notes.title: Realpolitiks 3 - Conquer the World, or Don't... The Choice is Yours!
notes.notes:
Greetings everyone!

An anticipated third installment in the Realpolitiks series has just launched to Early Access!

Watch the launch trailer here:

[previewyoutube=-kGI86dsYZ8;full][/previewyoutube]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2298690/Realpolitiks_3_Earth_and_Beyond/][b]Realpolitiks 3: Earth and Beyond[/b][/url] is here to put you into office. You are cordially invited to prove your political brilliance - pick from a range of [b]195 countries[/b], set up your [b]government[/b] and navigate the pitfalls of [b]domestic and international politics[/b]. A glorious destiny awaits - the domination of [b]not just the Earth, but the whole Solar system[/b]!

To achieve this ultimate goal, you will have to carefully consider a myriad of decisions, starting with the choice of a country you wish to lead. Taking control of any contemporary nation in order to fulfil your ambitions: from Afghanistan to Zimbabwe and everything in between. 

You will also need to select your optimal form of government, build your cabinet of ministers, improve your character’s skills - all while leading your country’s efforts in economic development, research, diplomacy, espionage or war. Will you lead your people to the stars, or to their ultimate doom?

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2298690/Realpolitiks_3_Earth_and_Beyond/]Realpolitiks 3: Earth and Beyond[/url] is available now in Early Access - with three game modes currently available - Realism, Overdrive and Sandbox. You can currently begin your political empire on Earth, before slowly expanding out into the solar system - with the option to lead any country existing in 2010, the starting year of the campaign.

The game is available with a 15% Launch Discount until October 29, and to celebrate the release, the previous games in the series are discounted as well. Check out the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/realpolitiksfranchise2024]Realpolitiks Franchise Sale[/url] to learn more, or simply purchase the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/46403/]Realpolitiks Franchise Bundle[/url] to get the best deal!

If you're interested in the game, don't hesitate to [url=https://discord.gg/ZwXekHkTDK]join the Realpolitiks HQ Discord server[/url] where you can chat with the developers and with other players too!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2298690/Realpolitiks_3_Earth_and_Beyond/

notes.title: Try Upcoming Fulqrum Publishing Games at Steam Next Fest Now!
notes.notes:
Greetings, everyone!

Steam Next Fest is upon us! With so many titles to choose from this week, it’s easy to get lost. And that’s why [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/FulqrumPublishing/]Fulqrum Publishing[/url] is on hand, with a diverse selection of three demos among which we are certain you can find a new favourite! Will you to take a stand  in the eternal conflict between Arcane Magic and Steampunk Revolution in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2458310/New_Arc_Line/]New Arc Line[/url], prove your political brilliance in a grand strategy that will take your legacy to the stars in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2298690/Realpolitiks_3_Earth_and_Beyond/]Realpolitiks 3: Earth and Beyond[/url], or become a master of sword and magic in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1182420/VED/]VED[/url]? 

[u][b][h3][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2458310/New_Arc_Line/]New Arc Line[/url][/h3]
[/b][/u]
Take a stand in the eternal conflict between Arcane Magic and Steampunk Revolution and tip the uneasy balance between sorcery, elves, dwarves and mysterious monsters on one side and steampunk gadgets, zeppelins, and tesla guns on the other in this single-player, party-based, story-rich RPG.

In the demo, you will be thrown right into the middle of a deadly epidemic of the Iron Plague - select from 2 classes and play as either a Voodoo Shaman or a Diesel Engineer of either the Human or Elven race, and investigate what's going on in the Leprosarium; a hospital specializing in treating patients in the Slums district suffering from the horrific disease. With several ways of completing the quest and moral decisions to make along the way, will you rise to the occasion?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2458310/New_Arc_Line/


[u][b][h3][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2298690/Realpolitiks_3_Earth_and_Beyond/]Realpolitiks 3: Earth and Beyond[/url][/h3][/b][/u]
Prove your political brilliance in a grand strategy like no other: pick any contemporary country, set up your government and navigate the pitfalls of domestic and international politics. A glorious destiny awaits - the domination of not just the Earth, but the whole Solar system!

The demo will allow you to govern either Germany or Mexico, and you will have 5 in-game years to show off your cunning leadership skills in the new, extreme Overdrive mode. At launch, any contemporary nation will be available for your ambitions, from Afghanistan to Zimbabwe and everything in between, and you will be able to enjoy different campaign modes to boot!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2298690/Realpolitiks_3_Earth_and_Beyond/


[u][b][h3][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1182420/VED/]VED[/url][/h3][/b][/u]
VED is a story-driven, hand-drawn RPG with a unique turn-based combat system and roguelite elements. Set in two different worlds, VED tells the story of Cyrus, a young hero who sets out on a quest to become a master of sword and magic, and save everything he knows from destruction.

The demo will let you sneak a peek at a very early part of the game's story - just enough to whet your appetite, but with no significant spoilers!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1182420/VED/


We are excited to hear what you think about the demos - please consider joining their individual Discord servers, and don't forget to wishlist and follow each of the games you like, so you can always stay up to date - there are many important announcements coming soon!

notes.title: Win a free copy of the game in Easter Scavenger Hunt Sweeptakes!
notes.notes:
I hope everyone is suitably hyped up for the Easter holidays, as we launch a [url=https://resistancegames.com/2022/04/13/easter-scavenger-hunt-sweepstakes/]5-day scavenger hunt[/url] filled with puzzles for you to solve.

The campaign started on April 14th 10 AM EEST and you have until April 19th 5:59 AM EEST to earn entries.

[b][h2]How it works[/h2][/b]
At the end of the campaign, we will draw five random winners. You can gain entries into the drawing by the following methods:

[list]
[*] Sign in (+1 entry)
[*] Share your personal referral link (+3 entries per friend who signs up using the link)
[*] Visit our [url=https://www.facebook.com/resistancegames/photos/a.622271548525888/1151469438939427]Facebook[/url] page (+1 entry)
[*] Visit our [url=https://www.instagram.com/p/CcSRHVLs--l/]Instagram[/url] profile (+1 entry)
[*] Visit our [url=https://resistancegames.com/2022/04/13/easter-scavenger-hunt-sweepstakes/]website[/url] (+1 entry)
[*] Retweet the giveaway announcement on [url=https://twitter.com/GamesResistance/status/1514166601242882055]Twitter[/url] (+1 entry)
[*] Daily bonus for visiting the campaign page and clicking the link (+1 entry per day)
[*] Five scavenger hunt puzzles (+5 entries each for the correct answer)
[/list]
The maximum amount of entries (excluding daily bonus entries and referrals) you can gain is 30.

Winners will be chosen and contacted by email next week, as we return from our holidays. (Make sure the email you use for the giveaway is valid!)

[h2][b]Puzzles?[/b][/h2]
Each day over the Easter weekend, from Thursday until Monday, we’ll post a puzzle on one of our social media channels. The type of puzzle and the platform it can be found on is different each day, so stay focused to know where to find the next clue! We will always post the clue of the day along with instructions where to find the next one.

Speaking of which, the first puzzle is found on our [url=https://www.facebook.com/resistancegames/photos/a.622271548525888/1151469438939427]Facebook[/url] page…

[h2][b]Prizes[/b][/h2]
We will draw a total of FIVE (5) winners at the end of the campaign!

One lucky winner will walk away with the grand prize:

[list]
[*] Company of Crime (Steam)
[*] Company of Crime Official Soundtrack (Steam)
[*] 50€ Steam Gift Card
[/list]
Because one prize is never enough, we will also be giving away:

[list]
[*] Company of Crime (Steam)
[*] 20€ Steam Gift Card
[/list]
And lastly, three (3) people will get:

[list]
[*] Company of Crime (Steam)
[*] 10€ Steam Gift Card
[/list]

Official rules can be found at [url=https://resistancegames.com/2022/04/13/easter-scavenger-hunt-sweepstakes/]the official website of Resistance Games[/url].

Good luck and happy hunting!

notes.title: Company of Crime - Update #4 is live!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37357906/455c20a0432c9f94709d115b7e0db7661fc93ed6.jpg[/img]
Top o' the mornin' to ya lads!

Yet another update for Company of Crime is now available for you to download and enjoy! 
This is the biggest content update so far and focused on Quality of Life updates and improvements such as the ability to rename your units, improving UI and re-balancing the Heat mechanic to allow more aggressive playstyle. You can read the full changelist down below.

Last but not least - a big thank you to all of you, who let us know what to fix and improve in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1229420/discussions/]Steam Forums[/url]. You help us make the game better for everyone. Thank you ❤️


[h2]Update 1.0.4.1065 - Changelog[/h2]

[b]Added[/b]
[list]
[*] Player can now change the name of the units
[*] Auto-resolve added for police campaign
[*] Enemy count depends now on mission type, location level and location type
[*] Preview damage when throwing a bottle

notes.title: Organised crime gets crazy in 1960s London - Company of Crime announced
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37357906/bef075ec4fc10c2a201096c19e2ebbd8b63c35a4.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone,

we are super excited to announce our newest project - [b]Company of Crime![/b]

The premise is rather simple either build an influential criminal gang or tear it down as fearless chief of Scotland Yard in this [b]tactical turn-based strategy![/b]

Check out the announcement trailer:

[previewyoutube=VmFB_ccNu4Q;full][/previewyoutube]
Company of Crime is a hybrid of empire builder and tactical strategy game that features a turn-based combat system with a heavy focus on melee. You can either play as the Criminal side or as the Police, where in each case you will have to build a team that consists of gang members possessing the different skills required to pull off criminal tasks, or detectives that have mastered the art of investigation.

The game takes place in London, the cultural capital of the world and home to a plethora of subcultures and businesses, during the vivid decade of 1960s, featuring beatniks, mods, lemonheads, rockers and every other cultural identity of that time. As you progress in the game, you will visit pubs, clubs, vets, tailors, harbours and many other locations around London as you expand your influence over the city. 

The big question is ultimately this: Will you become a leader of a ruthless gang and build an influential criminal empire, or head up an elite Scotland Yard task force and crack down on the rising tide of corruption?
